title: workflow.task.resolved payload
description: Emitted by BMS when something other than its completion in Notifications ends a workflow's task — today a review step's verdict in MAM (EP-22.6): the asset was approved or rejected, so the review task is done, with the verdict as its outcome. Consumed by Notifications, which closes the task.

by.description: Who gave the verdict — a user id, or `mam` for an automatic approval.

reviewPointId.description: The point the verdict named; absent when it named none (it then resolves every review step waiting on the asset).
